title: ✨ Ty Dolla $ign - Woke Up
description: Ty Dolla $ign song with a feature from Kanye, likely a freestyle given to him similar to "Guard Down". Has a minute of rapping and singing vocals from Kanye, as well as punch-ins and verses from Ty Dolla over the initial reference track. Samples "Paradise" by Jeremih. Mistaken as a LOVE EVERYONE track, since the producer for "Paradise" revealed Kanye had reached out Christmas 2016 for the stems - later using them to make an altered version of the song to use as background for a sentimental home video posted by Kim Kardashian to twitter. Also thought to be made later because "Paradise" wasn't released until December 2015, but it was found that the song was previewed before, with Jeremih's album having already been delayed multiple times since 2013. Original snippet leaked April 17th, 2024. Leaked after a successful Soakbuy.

title: CROP MUSCLE TEE (H17)
description:
Background: The YZY GAP Crop Muscle Tee was first seen on Ye during his visit and studio session with DJ Khaled on 01/21/2022.

It was initially planned for release in the Spring of 2023 as a part of the Spring 2023 collection. Due to controversies surrounding Ye at the time, the collection was cancelled, and the Crop Muscle Tee appeared in 2024 through 3rd party sellers, which Gap would liquidate to. 

The Gap had debranded these for production and did not put the YZY logo on the necks and covered the YEEZY GAP on the tags with black tape, most likely in an attempt to sell it in the US after the Termination, but backfired after Ye tweeted his Death Con tweet, and Gap decided to shut down all Yeezy Gap operations on 10/25/2022

The Crop Muscle Tee did not release on yeezy.com.

Sample documented wear by Ye:
• 01/21/2022 at a Studio Session with DJ Khaled
